more_info.overview: Ammonium persulphate is an inorganic salt containing ammonium and peroxydisulphate. Its chemical role is oxidation, which distinguishes it from ordinary ammonium sulphate. FDA lists ammonium persulphate among reagents for a particular modified-starch bleaching process, subject to process limits. That permission concerns treated food starch and does not establish unrestricted addition of the free reagent to finished foods.
more_info.banned_in:
No current country-wide food-use ban was confirmed in the regulatory sources checked in 2026.
EU and US food-additive permissions for this exact entry were not confirmed in the sources checked in 2026.
